_README: Hand-authored model data. scripts/extract-plans.mjs turns the PDFs in
assets-src/plans/ into images using the `pages` list below, and
Page labels are recorded here rather than read out of the PDF on purpose.
These brochures carry hidden/leftover content layers: pdftoppm renders only
the visible one, but pdftotext returns all of them, so extracted text names
the wrong sheet (the-daydreamer page 3 reads 'THE VISIONARY' and 'Basement
Floor Plan' when the sheet actually says 'First Floor Plan'). Every label
below was read off the rendered page.
`id` also names the output file: plans/img/<slug>-<id>.{webp,png}. An id
starting with 'elevation' is cropped with the elevation band, anything else
with the floor-plan band (see extract-plans.mjs). An optional `band`
[top, bottom] as a fraction of page height overrides that for one page -
the-visionary's title banner sits lower than the rest, and the default band
left the gold rule under it in the image.
Specs are null until Leavitt supplies them. NOTHING here may be guessed:
the brochures carry no square footage, bedroom or bath counts. `stories` is
filled in only because it is directly observable from the sheets in the set.
The templates render an honest 'Available on request' for every null.
